explication: This repository is an open-access Modern C++ course, not a software runtime. Its principal workflow is for a learner to study the lecture material, progressing from preparation and language fundamentals through advanced topics and practical engineering concerns. The README documents the course’s scope, teaching approach, and chapter topics through chapter 18; later chapter nodes are grounded in filenames in the tree, so their detailed contents and relationships are not inferred.
